title: Sculpt & Spice
description: Come for a yoga sculpt class, sip on your favorite seasonal lattes, shop and support local vendors, and connect with the community!
long_description:
Come for a yoga sculpt class, sip on your favorite seasonal lattes, shop and support local vendors, and connect with the community!

About this Event

Move for More: Sculpt & SpiceStart with a 50-minute mat-based Yoga Sculpt class designed to strengthen, tone, and leave you feeling energized. Then, stick around to enjoy a complimentary seasonal latte or tea from Toastique, pick and paint your own pumpkin, and shop a curated lineup of local vendors featuring all things wellness, lifestyle, and fall.

Agenda

🕑: 08:30 AM - 09:00 AM
Settle in 
Info: Pick a spot where one of the complimentary wellness goodie bags are, lay your yoga mat out, connect with those around you, settle into your space!

🕑: 09:00 AM - 10:00 AM
Sculpt
Host: Abbie Fisher - balanced.by.abs
Info: 50 minute body weight Yoga Sculpt class full of pulsing, toning and stretching! 

🕑: 10:00 AM - 11:30 AM
Shop & Sip 
Host: milesreadsalot
Info: Visit the local vendors pop-ups, get your FREE pumpkin spice latte or apple chai tea from Toastique, pick/paint a pumpkin, and connect with the community!

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Raleigh, Workshops in Raleigh.
